case_title: STEVE WHITE ET AL VS. ANTHONY MEJIA

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY WHITE, STEVE WHITE, NORA AS TO DEFENDANT MEJIA, ANTHONY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-20-2019 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-20-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO MAR-27-2019 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEVE WHITE IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF NORA WHITE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANTHONY MEJIA IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE WAS FILED ON DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT DOES NOT WAIVE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - (FEE FOR SERVICE: $75.00) SERVED MAR-06-2019, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT MEJIA, ANTHONY

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING CALENDAR OF MAR. 27, 2019. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT, PARTIES WERE PLACED UNDER OATH AND TESTIFIED. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED, THE COURT TAKES THIS MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. BOTH PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED BY THE COURT. JUDGE JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-27-2019 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM.
